wikipedia.extract: Hadropithecus is a medium-sized, extinct genus of lemur, or strepsirrhine primate, from Madagascar that includes a single species, Hadropithecus stenognathus. Due to its rarity and lack of sufficient skeletal remains, it is one of the least understood of the extinct lemurs.
wikipedia.title: Hadropithecus

wikipedia.extract: Archaeolemur is an extinct genus of subfossil lemurs known from the Quaternary of Madagascar. Archaeolemur is one of the most common and well-known of the extinct giant lemurs as hundreds of its bones have been discovered in fossil deposits across the island.
wikipedia.title: Archaeolemur

wikipedia.extract: Atelornis is a small genus of birds in the ground-roller family Brachypteraciidae. The genus is endemic to Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Atelornis

wikipedia.extract: Eurystomus is a genus of roller, one of the two genera in that family of birds. The name means ‘broad mouth’, from the Greek eurus (εὐρύς, ‘broad, wide’) and stoma (στόμα, ‘mouth’).
wikipedia.title: Eurystomus

commonNames.name: Papagaios Eclectus
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: Eclectus is a genus of parrot, the Psittaciformes, which consists of four known extant species known as eclectus parrots and the extinct Eclectus infectus, the oceanic eclectus parrot. The extant eclectus parrots are medium-sized parrots native to regions of Oceania, particularly New Guinea and Australia.
wikipedia.title: Eclectus

commonNames.name: tomato
commonNames.source: Database of Vascular Plants of Canada (VASCAN)

wikipedia.extract: The tomato (US: , UK: ; Solanum lycopersicum) is a plant whose fruit is an edible berry that is eaten as a vegetable. The tomato is a member of the nightshade family that includes tobacco, potato, and chili peppers.
wikipedia.title: Tomato

wikipedia.extract: The great albatrosses are seabirds in the genus Diomedea in the albatross family. The genus Diomedea formerly included all albatrosses except the sooty albatrosses, but in 1996 the genus was split, with the mollymawks and the North Pacific albatrosses both being elevated to separate genera.
wikipedia.title: Great albatross

wikipedia.extract: Aramides is a genus of birds in the family Rallidae.
wikipedia.title: Aramides

wikipedia.extract: Metriopelia is a genus of ground doves containing four species that live in the dry, upland habitats along the Andean mountain chain in South America. They have large wings and three species have orange skin around the eyes.
wikipedia.title: Metriopelia

wikipedia.extract: The blue-throated barbet (Psilopogon asiaticus) is a green Asian barbet native to the foothills of the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. It inhabits lowland and montane forests at elevations of 200–2,000 m (660–6,560 ft), frequenting fruiting trees.
wikipedia.title: Blue-throated barbet

wikipedia.extract: Collocalia is a genus of swifts, containing some of the smaller species termed "swiftlets". Formerly a catch-all genus for these, a number of its former members are now normally (though not by all authors) placed in Aerodramus.
wikipedia.title: Collocalia

wikipedia.extract: Chlorocebus is a genus of medium-sized primates from the family of Old World monkeys. Seven species are currently recognized.
wikipedia.title: Chlorocebus

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus mittermeieri Louis Jr., Coles, Andriantompohavana, Sommer, Engberg, Zaonarivelo, Mayor & Brenneman, 2006

wikipedia.extract: Mittermeier's mouse lemur (Microcebus mittermeieri) is a species of mouse lemur known only from Anjanaharibe-Sud Special Reserve in Madagascar. Mittermeier's mouse lemur is one of the smallest mouse lemurs, but is larger than Madame Berthe's mouse lemur, the smallest member of not only cheirogaleid family, but of all primates.
wikipedia.title: Mittermeier's mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: The dwarf lemurs are the lemurs of the genus Cheirogaleus. All of the species in this genus, like all other lemurs, are native to Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Dwarf lemur

commonNames.name: Black-and-white Ruffed Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-and-white ruffed lemur (Varecia variegata) is an endangered species of ruffed lemur, one of two which are endemic to the island of Madagascar. Despite having a larger range than the red ruffed lemur, it has a much smaller population that is spread out, living in lower population densities and reproductively isolated.
wikipedia.title: Black-and-white ruffed lemur

wikipedia.extract: The black-capped squirrel monkey (Saimiri boliviensis) is a species of New-World monkey native to the upper Amazon basin in Bolivia, western Brazil and eastern Peru. They weigh between 365 and 1,135 g (13 and 40 oz) and measure, from the head to the base of the tail, between 225 and 370 mm (9 and 15 in).
wikipedia.title: Black-capped squirrel monkey

wikipedia.extract: The blue-bellied parrot or purple-bellied parrot (Triclaria malachitacea) is the only species in its genus. It is generally considered endemic to the humid Atlantic Forest of southeastern Brazil, but there are two unconfirmed records from Misiones in Argentina.
wikipedia.title: Blue-bellied parrot

wikipedia.extract: The golden-mantled tamarin (Leontocebus tripartitus) is a tamarin species from South America. It is found in Ecuador and Peru, specifically in the upper Amazon (lowland), east of the Andes in Ecuador, and Northeast Peru; between the Rio Curaray and Rio Napo in Peru.
wikipedia.title: Golden-mantled tamarin

commonNames.name: Crowned Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The crowned lemur (Eulemur coronatus) is a lemur that is 31–36 cm (12–14 in) long and weighs 2 kg (4.4 lb). Its tail is about 42–51 cm (17–20 in) long.
wikipedia.title: Crowned lemur

wikipedia.extract: Caenorhabditis elegans () is a free-living transparent nematode about 1 mm in length that lives in temperate soil environments. It is the type species of its genus.
wikipedia.title: Caenorhabditis elegans

wikipedia.extract: The nematodes ( NEM-ə-tohdz, NEE-mə-), roundworms or eelworms constitute the phylum Nematoda (Ancient Greek: Νηματώδη; Latin: Nematoda). Species in the phylum inhabit a broad range of environments.
wikipedia.title: Nematode

wikipedia.extract: Flufftails (genus Sarothrura) are small birds related to rails and finfoots. There are nine species, seven of which are distributed across sub-Saharan Africa, with the remaining two in Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Flufftail

wikipedia.extract: Rhynchotus is a genus of birds in the tinamou family. This genus comprises two members of this South American family.
wikipedia.title: Rhynchotus

wikipedia.extract: Tinamus is a genus of birds in the tinamou family Tinamidae. This genus comprises some of the larger members of this South American family.
wikipedia.title: Tinamus

wikipedia.extract: The bird family Tytonidae, which includes the barn owls Tyto and the bay owls Phodilus, is one of the two families of owls, the other being the true owls or typical owls, Strigidae. Tytonidae are medium to large owls with large heads and characteristic heart-shaped faces.
wikipedia.title: Tytonidae

commonNames.name: Great Tinamou
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The great tinamou (Tinamus major) is a species of tinamou ground bird native to Central and South America. There are several subspecies, mostly differentiated by their coloration.
wikipedia.title: Great tinamou

commonNames.name: Coquerel's Sifaka
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Coquerel's sifaka (Propithecus coquereli) is a diurnal, medium-sized lemur of the sifaka genus Propithecus. It is native to northwest Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Coquerel's sifaka

wikipedia.extract: Abbott's booby (Papasula abbotti) is an endangered seabird of the sulid family, which includes gannets and boobies. It is a large booby and is placed within its own monotypic genus.
wikipedia.title: Abbott's booby

commonNames.name: Barking Owl
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The barking owl (Ninox connivens) or barking boobook, also known as the winking owl, is a nocturnal bird species native to mainland Australia and parts of New Guinea and the Moluccas. They are medium-sized brown owls and have a characteristic voice with calls ranging from a barking dog noise to an intense human-like howl.
wikipedia.title: Barking owl

commonNames.name: Tonkean Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Tonkean black macaque or Tonkean macaque (Macaca tonkeana) is a species of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is endemic to central Sulawesi and the nearby Togian Islands in Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Tonkean macaque

commonNames.name: Black-horned Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black capuchin (Sapajus nigritus), also known as the black-horned capuchin, is a capuchin monkey from the Atlantic Forest in south-eastern Brazil and far north-eastern Argentina. Historically, it was included as a subspecies of the tufted capuchin.
wikipedia.title: Black capuchin

commonNames.name: Ankarana Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Ankarana sportive lemur (Lepilemur ankaranensis), or Ankarana weasel lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. It is one of the smaller sportive lemurs with a total length of about 53 cm (21 in), including 25 cm (9.8 in) of tail.
wikipedia.title: Ankarana sportive lemur

commonNames.name: Goodman's Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Goodman's mouse lemur (Microcebus lehilahytsara) is a species of mouse lemur from the region near Andasibe in eastern Madagascar. The species is named in honor of primatologist Steven M. Goodman.
wikipedia.title: Goodman's mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Pyrrhura (Ancient Greek for red/fire tail) is a genus of parrots in the Arini tribe. They occur in tropical and subtropical South America and southern Central America (Panama and Costa Rica).
wikipedia.title: Pyrrhura

wikipedia.extract: Aprosmictus is a genus of parrots in the family Psittaculidae native to Oceania. Several former members, including the Australian king parrot, are now placed in the genus Alisterus.
wikipedia.title: Aprosmictus

commonNames.name: Chimpanzee
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The chimpanzee (; Pan troglodytes), commonly abbreviated to chimp, is a medium-sized great ape species found in the forests and savannas of equatorial Africa. It has four confirmed subspecies and a fifth proposed one.
wikipedia.title: Chimpanzee

commonNames.name: Western Gorilla
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The western gorilla (Gorilla gorilla) is a great ape found in Africa, one of two species of the hominine genus Gorilla. Large and robust with males weighing around 168 kilograms (370 lb), the species is found in a region of midwest Africa, geographically isolated from the eastern gorilla (Gorilla beringei).
wikipedia.title: Western gorilla

wikipedia.extract: Gorillas are large, primarily herbivorous, great apes that live in the tropical forests of equatorial Africa. The genus Gorilla is divided into two species: the eastern gorilla and the western gorilla, and either four or five subspecies.
wikipedia.title: Gorilla

commonNames.name: Crossley's Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The furry-eared dwarf lemur (Cheirogaleus crossleyi), or Crossley's dwarf lemur, only found on the island of Madagascar, as with all other lemurs. It has a pelage coloration that is red-brown dorsally and gray ventrally.
wikipedia.title: Furry-eared dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: The large tree finch (Camarhynchus psittacula) is a species of bird in the Darwin's finch group of the tanager family Thraupidae. It is endemic to the Galapagos Islands.
wikipedia.title: Large tree finch

wikipedia.extract: Doryfera is a genus of hummingbird in the family Trochilidae.
wikipedia.title: Doryfera

commonNames.name: Emperor Fairywren
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The emperor fairywren (Malurus cyanocephalus) is a species of bird in the Australasian wren family, Maluridae. It is found in New Guinea in its natural habitat of subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.
wikipedia.title: Emperor fairywren

wikipedia.extract: The blue duck (Hymenolaimus malacorhynchos) or whio is a member of the duck, goose and swan family, Anatidae and is endemic to New Zealand. It is the only individual species belonging to the genus Hymenolaimus.
wikipedia.title: Blue duck

wikipedia.extract: Attagis is a genus of seedsnipe, a South American family of small gregarious waders which have adapted to a vegetarian diet. These birds look superficially like partridges in structure and bill shape.
wikipedia.title: Attagis

wikipedia.extract: Turacoena is a small genus of doves in the family Columbidae that are found in Indonesia. The genus was introduced in 1854 by the French naturalist Charles Lucien Bonaparte.
wikipedia.title: Turacoena

wikipedia.extract: Biziura is a genus of stiff-tailed ducks endemic to Australasia and containing one living and one subfossil species.
wikipedia.title: Biziura

commonNames.name: Kinda Baboon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Kinda baboon (Papio kindae) is a species of baboon present in the miombo woodlands of Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Zambia, and possibly western Tanzania. It was once considered a subspecies of the yellow baboon (P. cynocephalus), then distinct enough to merit status as full species (P. kindae) under the phylogenetic species concept.
wikipedia.title: Kinda baboon

wikipedia.extract: Malacorhynchus is a genus of duck within the family Anatidae. It was established in 1831 by English ornithologist William Swainson, when he proposed moving the pink-eared duck into a subgenus (Malacorhynchus) based on unique characters of its beak and toes.
wikipedia.title: Malacorhynchus

wikipedia.extract: Chenonetta is a genus of dabbling duck. One species is extinct, while the other is extant.
wikipedia.title: Chenonetta

wikipedia.extract: The typical falconets, Microhierax, are a bird of prey genus in the family Falconidae. They are found in southeast Asia and the smallest members of Falconiformes, averaging about 15 cm (5.9 in) in length and 35 g (1.2 oz) in weight.
wikipedia.title: Microhierax

wikipedia.extract: Daptrius is a genus of birds of prey in the family Falconidae comprising most of the caracaras. All members are endemic to South America, except for the yellow-headed caracara, which is also found in Costa Rica and Panama.
wikipedia.title: Daptrius

commonNames.name: Cao-vit Gibbon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The eastern black crested gibbon (Nomascus nasutus), also called Cao-vit black crested gibbon or the Cao-vit crested gibbon, is a Critically Endangered species of gibbon from southeast China and northern Vietnam. The term "Cao-vit" originated from the sounds of their calls or songs that villagers of Ngoc Khe, Phong Nam and Ngoc Con communes of Trung Khanh District, Cao Bang Province of Vietnam use to name for them.
wikipedia.title: Eastern black crested gibbon

commonNames.name: Domestic silk moth
commonNames.source: Global Register of Introduced and Invasive Species - United States (Contiguous) (ver.2.0, 2022)

wikipedia.extract: Bombyx mori, commonly known as the domestic silk moth, is a domesticated moth species belonging to the family Bombycidae. It is the closest relative of Bombyx mandarina, the wild silk moth.
wikipedia.title: Bombyx mori

wikipedia.extract: The adzebills are two species of gruiform birds belonging to the genus Aptornis, the sole member of the extinct family Aptornithidae, which were endemic to New Zealand. The species were divided between the North Island and South Island of the country, with Aptornis otidiformis being the North Island adzebill, and Aptornis defossor being the South Island adzebill.
wikipedia.title: Adzebill

wikipedia.extract: The Heliornithidae are a small family of tropical birds with webbed lobes on their feet like those of grebes and coots. The family overall are known as finfoots, although one species is known as a sungrebe.
wikipedia.title: Heliornithidae

wikipedia.extract: Rallus is a genus of wetland birds of the rail family. Sometimes, the genera Lewinia and Gallirallus are included in it.
wikipedia.title: Rallus

commonNames.name: Hoffmann’s Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Hoffmanns's titi monkey (Plecturocebus hoffmannsi) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Brazil. It was described as Callicebus hoffmannsi in 1908.
wikipedia.title: Hoffmanns's titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: The anhinga (; Anhinga anhinga), sometimes called darter, American darter, snakebird, or water turkey, is a water bird of the warmer parts of the Americas. The word anhinga comes from a'ñinga in the Brazilian Tupi language and means "devil bird" or "snake bird".
wikipedia.title: Anhinga

wikipedia.extract: Phoenicopterus is a genus of birds in the flamingo family Phoenicopteridae.
wikipedia.title: Phoenicopterus

wikipedia.extract: The American flamingo (Phoenicopterus ruber) is a large species of flamingo native to the West Indies, northern South America (including the Galápagos Islands) and the Yucatán Peninsula. It is closely related to the greater flamingo and Chilean flamingo, and was formerly considered conspecific with the greater flamingo, but that treatment is now widely viewed (e.g.
wikipedia.title: American flamingo

commonNames.name: Pale Fork-marked Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The pale fork-marked lemur (Phaner pallescens), or western fork-marked lemur, is a species of lemur known from western Madagascar; south of the Fiherenana River to the region of Soalala. It is said to be the smallest fork-marked species.
wikipedia.title: Pale fork-marked lemur

wikipedia.extract: Cranes are a type of large bird with long legs and necks in the biological family Gruidae of the order Gruiformes. The family has 15 species placed in four genera which are Antigone, Balearica, Leucogeranus, and Grus.
wikipedia.title: Crane (bird)

wikipedia.extract: Arborophila is a bird genus in the family Phasianidae. The genus has the second most members within the Galliformes after Pternistis, although Arborophila species vary very little in bodily proportions with different species varying only in colouration/patterning and overall size.
wikipedia.title: Arborophila

wikipedia.extract: An echinoderm () is any animal of the phylum Echinodermata (), which includes starfish, brittle stars, sea urchins, sand dollars and sea cucumbers, as well as the sessile sea lilies or "stone lilies". While bilaterally symmetrical as larvae, as adults echinoderms are recognisable by their usually five-pointed radial symmetry (pentamerous symmetry), and are found on the sea bed at every ocean depth from the intertidal zone to the abyssal zone.
wikipedia.title: Echinoderm

wikipedia.extract: The common brown lemur (Eulemur fulvus) is a species of lemur in the family Lemuridae. It is found in Madagascar and has been introduced to Mayotte.
wikipedia.title: Common brown lemur

wikipedia.extract: Procellariiformes is an order of seabirds that comprises four families; the albatrosses, the petrels and shearwaters, and two families of storm petrels. Formerly called Tubinares and still called tubenoses in English, Procellariiformes are often referred to collectively as the petrels, a term that has been applied to all members of the order, or more commonly all the families except the albatrosses.
wikipedia.title: Procellariiformes

wikipedia.extract: The bird family Sulidae comprises the gannets and boobies. Collectively called sulids, they are medium-large coastal seabirds that plunge-dive for fish and similar prey.
wikipedia.title: Sulidae

wikipedia.extract: Grebes () are aquatic diving birds in the order Podicipediformes (). Grebes are widely distributed freshwater birds, with some species also found in marine habitats during migration and winter.
wikipedia.title: Grebe

wikipedia.extract: The Pelecanidae is a family of pelecaniform birds within the Pelecani that contains three genera: the extinct Eopelecanus and Miopelecanus and the extant Pelecanus. Pelecanids have existed since the late Eocene (Priabonian) and they still exist today.
wikipedia.title: Pelecanidae

wikipedia.extract: The crescentchests are a genus, Melanopareia, of suboscine passerine birds from South America. The genus has long been placed with the tapaculos in the family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Crescentchest

wikipedia.extract: Cerorhinca is a genus of auk containing the rhinoceros auklet and several fossil species.
wikipedia.title: Cerorhinca

commonNames.name: Golden-backed Squirrel Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The bare-eared squirrel monkey (Saimiri ustus) is a squirrel monkey endemic to Brazil and possibly eastern Bolivia.
wikipedia.title: Bare-eared squirrel monkey

wikipedia.extract: Piprites is a genus of bird currently placed in the family Tyrannidae. Prior to 1971, the genus was placed in the family Pipridae; its designation was initially changed based on morphological evidence, and genetic evidence confirmed its placement in 2009.
wikipedia.title: Piprites

wikipedia.extract: Pipreola is a genus of bird in the family Cotingidae. Together with Ampelioides tschudii, they are collectively known as fruiteaters.
wikipedia.title: Pipreola

wikipedia.extract: The great bustard (Otis tarda) is a bird in the bustard family, and the only living member of the genus Otis. It breeds in open grasslands and farmland from northern Morocco, South and Central Europe to temperate Central and East Asia.
wikipedia.title: Great bustard

wikipedia.extract: The western honey bee (Apis mellifera) is the most common of the 7–12 species of honey bees worldwide. The genus name Apis is Latin for 'bee', and mellifera is the Latin for 'honey-bearing' or 'honey-carrying', referring to the species' production of honey.
wikipedia.title: Western honey bee

wikipedia.extract: Coeligena is a genus of South American hummingbirds. Species in the genus are commonly called incas or starfrontlets.
wikipedia.title: Coeligena

wikipedia.extract: Aepyornis is an extinct genus of elephant bird formerly endemic to Madagascar. The genus had two species, the smaller A. hildebrandti and the larger A. maximus, which is possibly the largest bird ever to have lived.
wikipedia.title: Aepyornis

commonNames.name: African Clawed Frog
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The African clawed frog (Xenopus laevis), also known as simply xenopus, African clawed toad, African claw-toed frog or the platanna) is a species of African aquatic frog of the family Pipidae. Its name is derived from the short black claws on its feet.
wikipedia.title: African clawed frog

wikipedia.extract: Hemiphaga is a genus of large pigeons from New Zealand and Norfolk Island. There are two species, one of which is divided into two subspecies.
wikipedia.title: Hemiphaga

wikipedia.extract: Nine families of largely arboreal birds make up the order Piciformes (), the best-known of them being the Picidae, which includes the woodpeckers and close relatives. The Piciformes contain about 71 living genera with a little over 450 species, of which the Picidae make up about half.
wikipedia.title: Piciformes

wikipedia.extract: Phoenicopteriformes is a group of water birds which comprises flamingos and their extinct relatives. Flamingos (Phoenicopteriformes) and the closely related grebes (Podicipedidae) are contained in the parent clade Mirandornithes.
wikipedia.title: Phoenicopteriformes

commonNames.name: Black-shanked Douc Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-shanked douc (Pygathrix nigripes) is an endangered species of douc found mostly in the forests of Eastern Cambodia, with some smaller populations in Southern Vietnam. The region they are mostly found in is called the Annamite Range, a mountainous area that passes through Cambodia and Vietnam.
wikipedia.title: Black-shanked douc

wikipedia.extract: The chimango caracara (Daptrius chimango), also known as chimango or tiuque, is a species of bird of prey in the family Falconidae, the falcons and caracaras. It is found in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay, as a vagrant on the Falkland Islands and has been introduced on Rapa Nui.
wikipedia.title: Chimango caracara

wikipedia.extract: Myiobius is a genus of passerine birds in the family Onychorhynchidae. The genus was previously considered to belong to the Tyrannidae or Tityridae.
wikipedia.title: Myiobius

wikipedia.extract: The family Threskiornithidae includes 35 extant species of large wading birds, and one more that became extinct in historical times. The family has been traditionally classified into two subfamilies, the ibises and the spoonbills; however, recent genetic studies have cast doubt on this arrangement, and have found the spoonbills to be nested within the Old World ibises, and the New World ibises as an early offshoot.
wikipedia.title: Threskiornithidae

commonNames.name: Danfoss' Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus danfossi Olivieri, Zimmermann, Randrianambinina, Rassoloharijaona, Rakotondravony, Gsuchanski et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Danfoss's mouse lemur (Microcebus danfossi), or the Ambarijeby mouse lemur, is a species of mouse lemur endemic to Madagascar. It lives in western deciduous forest within a limited range between the Sofia River and the Maevarano River.
wikipedia.title: Danfoss's mouse lemur

commonNames.name: Bongolava Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus bongolavensis Olivieri, Zimmermann, Randrianambinina, Rassoloharijaona, Rakotondravony, Gsuchanski et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: The Bongolava mouse lemur (Microcebus bongolavensis) is a species of mouse lemur endemic to Madagascar. It lives in western deciduous forest within a limited range, including Bongolava Forest and Ambodimahabibo Forest between the Sofia River and the Mahajamba River.
wikipedia.title: Bongolava mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Claire's mouse lemur (Microcebus mamiratra), or the Nosy Be mouse lemur, is a newly described species of lemur from the genus of the mouse lemurs (Microcebus). It lives on the island Nosy Bé in the Antsiranana province of Madagascar, and on the mainland near the village of Manehoka, including Lokobe Reserve.
wikipedia.title: Claire's mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Baryphthengus is a genus of birds in the family Momotidae. They are found in forests of South and Central America.
wikipedia.title: Baryphthengus

commonNames.name: Black-billed Turaco
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-billed turaco (Tauraco schuettii) is a medium-sized turaco, an endemic family to sub-Saharan Africa. It is a resident breeder in the forests of central Africa, found in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, West Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda and South Sudan.
wikipedia.title: Black-billed turaco

wikipedia.extract: The horned guan (Oreophasis derbianus) is an endangered species in an ancient group of birds of the family Cracidae, which are related to the Australasian megapodes or mound builders (Megapodiidae). It is found in Mexico, Guatemala, and possibly Honduras.
wikipedia.title: Horned guan

wikipedia.extract: The Emilia's marmoset (Mico emiliae), also known as Snethlage's marmoset, is a marmoset endemic to Brazil. It is found only in the Brazilian states of Pará and Mato Grosso.
wikipedia.title: Emilia's marmoset

commonNames.name: Chowchilla
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The chowchilla (Orthonyx spaldingii) is a passerine bird in the family Orthonychidae. It is endemic to Australia.
wikipedia.title: Chowchilla

wikipedia.extract: Orthonychidae is a clade of passerine birds endemic to Australia and New Guinea. It encompasses the genus Orthonyx, (from Ancient Greek ὀρθός (orthós), meaning "straight", and ὄνῠξ (ónŭx), meaning "claw") including the logrunners and the chowchilla.
wikipedia.title: Orthonychidae

wikipedia.extract: The cotton-top tamarin (Saguinus oedipus) is a small New World monkey weighing less than 0.5 kg (1.1 lb). One of the smallest primates, the cotton-top tamarin is easily recognized by the long, white sagittal crest extending from its forehead to its shoulders.
wikipedia.title: Cotton-top tamarin

commonNames.name: Goeldi’s Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Cattle (Bos taurus) are large, domesticated, bovid ungulates widely kept as livestock. They are prominent modern members of the subfamily Bovinae and the most widespread species of the genus Bos.
wikipedia.title: Cattle

wikipedia.extract: Pardirallus is a genus of bird in the family Rallidae. It contains three species native to marshland areas of Southern, Central America and the Caribbean, although fossil evidence indicates they once ranged north to what is now Idaho.
wikipedia.title: Pardirallus

commonNames.name: Hainan Gibbon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Hainan black-crested gibbon (Nomascus hainanus), also called the Hainan gibbon, is a Critically Endangered species of gibbon found only on Hainan Island, in the South China Sea. Its habitat consists of broad-leaved forests and semi-deciduous monsoon forests.
wikipedia.title: Hainan black crested gibbon

commonNames.name: Emperor Penguin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The emperor penguin (Aptenodytes forsteri) is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguin species and is endemic to Antarctica. The male and female are similar in plumage and size, reaching 100 cm (39 in) in length and weighing from 22 to 45 kg (49 to 99 lb).
wikipedia.title: Emperor penguin

wikipedia.extract: Surniculus is a small genus of birds in the cuckoo family. Its four members are found in tropical Asia and the Philippines.
wikipedia.title: Surniculus

wikipedia.extract: The bare-faced ibis (Phimosus infuscatus), also known as the whispering ibis, is a species of bird in the family Threskiornithidae, in the monotypic genus Phimosus.
wikipedia.title: Bare-faced ibis

wikipedia.extract: Neafrapus is a genus of swift in the family Apodidae.
wikipedia.title: Neafrapus

commonNames.name: Pomace fly
commonNames.source: Global Register of Introduced and Invasive Species - Hawaii, United States (ver.2.0, 2022)

wikipedia.extract: Drosophila melanogaster is a species of fly (an insect of the order Diptera) in the family Drosophilidae. The species is often referred to as the fruit fly or lesser fruit fly, or less commonly the "vinegar fly", "pomace fly", or "banana fly".
wikipedia.title: Drosophila melanogaster

wikipedia.extract: The tooth-billed pigeons are the only genus (Didunculus) of the subfamily Didunculinae, in the pigeon and dove family, (Columbidae). It has no close living relatives, but it has been shown to be genetically close to the dodo, and the genus name Didunculus means "little dodo".
wikipedia.title: Didunculus

wikipedia.extract: Geopelia is a genus of small, long-tailed doves in the family Columbidae. They are native to South-east Asia and Australasia and are most often found in open country and scrubland.
wikipedia.title: Geopelia

commonNames.name: Barred Owl
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The barred owl (Strix varia), also known as the northern barred owl, striped owl or, more informally, hoot owl or eight hooter, is a North American large species of owl. A member of the true owl family, Strigidae, they belong to the genus Strix, which is also the origin of the family's name under Linnaean taxonomy.
wikipedia.title: Barred owl

wikipedia.extract: Aegolius is a genus of small true owls. The genus name is from Latin, aegolius, is a type of screech owl that was thought to be a bird of ill omen.
wikipedia.title: Aegolius

commonNames.name: Guinea Baboon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Guinea baboon (Papio papio) is a baboon from the Old World monkey family. Some (older) classifications list only two species in the genus Papio, this one and the hamadryas baboon.
wikipedia.title: Guinea baboon

wikipedia.extract: Grallaricula is a genus of bird in the antpitta family Grallariidae.
wikipedia.title: Grallaricula

commonNames.name: Eastern Woolly Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The eastern woolly lemur (Avahi laniger), also known as the eastern avahi or Gmelin's woolly lemur, is a species of woolly lemur native to eastern Madagascar, where it lives in the wet tropical rainforest at low elevations along the eastern coast of the island or they can also inhabit the northern tip of the island with other species. The woolly lemur name refers to their thick, tightly curled hair, whereas their generic name avahi refers to their high-pitched defensive call.
wikipedia.title: Eastern woolly lemur

commonNames.name: Hairy-eared Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The hairy-eared dwarf lemur (Allocebus trichotis), or hairy-eared mouse lemur, is one of the most scarcely known lemurs. A. trichotis is a nocturnal lemur that is endemic to Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Hairy-eared dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: The crested bobwhite (Colinus cristatus) is a species of bird in the family Odontophoridae. It is found in northern South America, extending through Panama to just reach Costa Rica.
wikipedia.title: Crested bobwhite

wikipedia.extract: Nyctyornis is a genus of the bee-eaters, near passerine birds in the family Meropidae. There are just two members of this group, which occur in tropical south and southeastern Asia.
wikipedia.title: Nyctyornis

wikipedia.extract: Climacteris is a genus of bird in the family Climacteridae. These birds and the other members of the family, genus Cormobates, are similar to Northern Hemisphere creepers, Certhiidae, in climbing helically up tree trunks looking for insect food.
wikipedia.title: Climacteris

commonNames.name: Jolly's Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus jollyae Louis Jr., Coles, Andriantompohavana, Sommer, Engberg, Zaonarivelo, Mayor & Brenneman, 2006

wikipedia.extract: Jolly's mouse lemur (Microcebus jollyae) is a species of mouse lemur from Mananjary and Kianjavato in Madagascar. The species is named in honor of primatologist Alison Jolly.
wikipedia.title: Jolly's mouse lemur

commonNames.name: Northern Giant Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The northern giant mouse lemur (Mirza zaza), or northern dwarf lemur, is a species of lemur discovered in 2005. They are part of the primate order, and classified in the family Cheirogaleidae.
wikipedia.title: Northern giant mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Sequoia sempervirens (), the coast redwood, is the sole living species of the genus Sequoia in the cypress family, Cupressaceae. Other common names include coastal redwood and California redwood.
wikipedia.title: Sequoia sempervirens

wikipedia.extract: Neodrepanis is a bird genus in the family Philepittidae.
wikipedia.title: Neodrepanis

commonNames.name: Australian Owlet-nightjar
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Australian owlet-nightjar (Aegotheles cristatus) is a nocturnal bird found in open woodland across Australia and in southern New Guinea. It is the smallest nocturnal bird found in Australia, making it prone to predation.
wikipedia.title: Australian owlet-nightjar

wikipedia.extract: The African bush elephant (Loxodonta africana), also known as the African savanna elephant, is a species of elephant native to sub-Saharan Africa and the largest living terrestrial animal, with fully grown bulls reaching an average shoulder height of 3.04–3.36 m (10.0–11.0 ft) and a body mass of 5.2–6.9 t (5.7–7.6 short tons); the largest recorded specimen had a shoulder height of 3.96 m (13.0 ft) and an estimated body mass of 10.4 t (11.5 short tons). It is characterised by its long prehensile trunk with two finger-like processes; a concave back; large ears which help reduce body heat; and sturdy tusks that are noticeably curved.
wikipedia.title: African bush elephant

wikipedia.extract: Snowornis is a genus of birds in the family Cotingidae. The species were formerly included in the genus Lipaugus, The genus Snowornis was introduced in 2001 by Richard Prum with the grey-tailed piha as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Snowornis

wikipedia.extract: Amphibians are ectothermic, anamniotic, four-limbed vertebrate animals that constitute the class Amphibia. In its broadest sense, it is a paraphyletic group encompassing all tetrapods, but excluding the amniotes (tetrapods with an amniotic membrane, such as modern reptiles, birds and mammals).
wikipedia.title: Amphibian

wikipedia.extract: Semnopithecus is a genus of Old World monkeys native to the Indian subcontinent, with all species with the exception of two being commonly known as gray langurs. Traditionally only the species Semnopithecus entellus was recognized, but since about 2001 additional species have been recognized.
wikipedia.title: Semnopithecus

wikipedia.extract: Myiopsitta is a genus of parrots in the family Psittacidae. They are native to southeastern South America, from Bolivia and southern Brazil, south to central Argentina.
wikipedia.title: Myiopsitta

wikipedia.extract: Brown doves are members of the genus Phapitreron in the pigeon family. Their common name refers to their overall brown coloration.
wikipedia.title: Brown dove

wikipedia.extract: Petrophassa, commonly known as the rock pigeons, is a small genus of doves in the family Columbidae native to Australia, and similar to bronzewing pigeons. The genus was introduced in 1841 by the English ornithologist and bird artist John Gould with the white-quilled rock pigeon (Petrophassa albipennis) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Petrophassa

commonNames.name: Golden-bellied Mangabey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The golden-bellied mangabey (Cercocebus chrysogaster) is an Endangered Old World monkey found in swampy, humid forests south of the Congo River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It was formerly considered a subspecies of the agile mangabey (C. agilis).
wikipedia.title: Golden-bellied mangabey

commonNames.name: Black Mangabey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black crested mangabey (Lophocebus aterrimus) is a species of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is only found in Democratic Republic of the Congo with a small habitat extending to Angola.
wikipedia.title: Black crested mangabey

wikipedia.extract: The Ecuadorian mantled howler (Alouatta palliata aequatorialis) is a subspecies of the mantled howler, A. palliata. It ranges from Panama (or possibly the eastern tip of Costa Rica) through Colombia and Ecuador into northern Peru.
wikipedia.title: Ecuadorian mantled howler

wikipedia.extract: The golden-mantled howler (Alouatta palliata palliata) is a subspecies of the mantled howler, A. palliata. It ranges throughout much of Central America, in Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica, and possibly Panama.
wikipedia.title: Golden-mantled howler

wikipedia.extract: The Azuero howler (Alouatta coibensis trabeata) a type of monkey that is a subspecies of the Coiba Island howler A. coibensis. This subspecies is endemic to the Azuero Peninsula in Panama.
wikipedia.title: Azuero howler

wikipedia.extract: The green sea turtle (Chelonia mydas), also known as the green turtle, black sea turtle, and Pacific green turtle, is a species of large sea turtle of the family Cheloniidae. It is the only species in the genus Chelonia.
wikipedia.title: Green sea turtle

commonNames.name: Claire's Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus mamiratra Andriantompohavana, Zaonarivelo, Engberg, Randriamampionona, McGuire, Shore et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Claire's mouse lemur (Microcebus mamiratra), or the Nosy Be mouse lemur, is a newly described species of lemur from the genus of the mouse lemurs (Microcebus). It lives on the island Nosy Bé in the Antsiranana province of Madagascar, and on the mainland near the village of Manehoka, including Lokobe Reserve.
wikipedia.title: Claire's mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: The lion (Panthera leo) is a large cat of the genus Panthera, currently ranging only in Sub-Saharan Africa and India. It has a muscular, broad-chested body; a short, rounded head; round ears; and a dark, hairy tuft at the tip of its tail.
wikipedia.title: Lion

wikipedia.extract: The cat (Felis catus), also called domestic cat and house cat, is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal. It is a member of Felidae, the family of mammals in the order Carnivora also colloquially referred to as cats.
wikipedia.title: Cat

wikipedia.extract: Agaricus bisporus, the cultivated mushroom, is a basidiomycete mushroom native to grasslands in Eurasia and North America. It is cultivated in more than 70 countries and is one of the most commonly and widely consumed mushrooms in the world.
wikipedia.title: Agaricus bisporus

wikipedia.extract: Strongylocentrotus purpuratus is a species of sea urchin in the family Strongylocentrotidae, which is commonly known as the purple sea urchin or Pacific purple sea urchin. It lives along the eastern edge of the Pacific Ocean extending from Ensenada, Mexico, to British Columbia, Canada.
wikipedia.title: Strongylocentrotus purpuratus

wikipedia.extract: Pomatostomus is a genus of small to medium-sized birds endemic to Australia-New Guinea. All four species are distributed in Australia, and only the grey-crowned babbler could also be found in south New Guinea.
wikipedia.title: Pomatostomus

commonNames.name: Black Lion Tamarin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Golden-humped lion tamarin
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The black lion tamarin (Leontopithecus chrysopygus), also known as the golden-rumped lion tamarin, is a lion tamarin endemic to the Brazilian state of São Paulo, almost exclusively at the Morro do Diabo State Park. It was thought to be extinct for 65 years until its rediscovery in 1970.
wikipedia.title: Black lion tamarin

commonNames.name: Australian Brushturkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Australian brushturkey, Australian brush-turkey, or gweela (Alectura lathami), also commonly called the bush turkey, scrub turkey, or just brushturkey, is a large mound-building bird of the family Megapodiidae. It is found in eastern Australia, ranging from Far North Queensland to the south coast of New South Wales, and has also been introduced to Kangaroo Island in South Australia.
wikipedia.title: Australian brushturkey

commonNames.name: Milne-Edward's Sifaka
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Milne-Edwards's sifaka (Propithecus edwardsi), or Milne-Edwards's simpona, is a large arboreal, diurnal lemur endemic to the eastern coastal rainforest of Madagascar. Milne-Edwards's sifaka is characterized by a black body with a light-colored "saddle" on the lower part of its back.
wikipedia.title: Milne-Edwards's sifaka

commonNames.name: Green Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The green monkey (Chlorocebus sabaeus), also known as the sabaeus monkey, is an Old World monkey with golden-green fur and pale hands and feet. The tip of the tail is golden yellow as are the backs of the thighs and cheek whiskers.
wikipedia.title: Green monkey

wikipedia.extract: The brown-backed bearded saki (Chiropotes israelita) is one of five species of bearded saki, a type of New World monkey. It is endemic to the Amazon in north-western Brazil (north of the Rio Negro and west of the Branco River) and southern Venezuela.
wikipedia.title: Brown-backed bearded saki

wikipedia.extract: The genus Syrmaticus contains the five species of long-tailed pheasants. The males have short spurs and usually red facial wattles, but otherwise differ wildly in appearance.
wikipedia.title: Syrmaticus

wikipedia.extract: Tragopan is a bird genus in the pheasant family Phasianidae. Member of the genus are colloquially called "horned pheasants" because males have two brightly colored, fleshy horns on their head that can be erected during courtship displays, despite this name, they are not true pheasants and are not closely related to them.
wikipedia.title: Tragopan

wikipedia.extract: Neurospora crassa is a type of red bread mold of the phylum Ascomycota. The genus name, meaning 'nerve spore' in Greek, refers to the characteristic striations on the spores.
wikipedia.title: Neurospora crassa

commonNames.name: Eastern Hoolock Gibbon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The eastern hoolock gibbon (Hoolock leuconedys) is a primate from the gibbon family, Hylobatidae. It is one of three species of hoolock gibbon.
wikipedia.title: Eastern hoolock gibbon

wikipedia.extract: Monasa is a genus of puffbirds in the Bucconidae family. The genus was described by the French ornithologist Louis Pierre Vieillot in 1816 with the black nunbird (Monasa atra) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Monasa

commonNames.name: Booted Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The booted macaque (Macaca ochreata) is a macaque of the Sulawesi Island, Indonesia. This Old World monkey is diurnal and spends most of the day in the trees.
wikipedia.title: Booted macaque

commonNames.name: Heck's Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Heck's macaque (Macaca hecki) is a macaque of Sulawesi, Indonesia. This Old World monkey is diurnal.
wikipedia.title: Heck's macaque

wikipedia.extract: Theristicus is a genus of birds in the family Threskiornithidae. They are found in open, grassy habitats in South America.
wikipedia.title: Theristicus

wikipedia.extract: Crateroscelis is a songbird genus of the Australasian "warbler" family (Acanthizidae). It was formerly placed in the Pardalotidae, which are now considered monotypic to genus.
wikipedia.title: Crateroscelis

wikipedia.extract: Crinifer is a genus of birds in the turaco family. They are restricted to Africa.
wikipedia.title: Crinifer

commonNames.name: Grey-handed Night Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The gray-handed night monkey (Aotus griseimembra) is a species of night monkey formerly considered a subspecies of Gray-bellied night monkey of the family Aotidae. Its range consists of parts of Colombia and Venezuela.
wikipedia.title: Gray-handed night monkey

wikipedia.extract: Spilornis is a genus of bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. As adults all have dark crowns, and bright yellow eyes and cere.
wikipedia.title: Spilornis

wikipedia.extract: Cypsiurus is a genus of birds in the swift family Apodidae. It includes three species, which were formerly considered to be conspecific due to their similarity.
wikipedia.title: Cypsiurus

wikipedia.extract: The bird family Casuariidae has four surviving members: the three species of cassowary and the emu. All living members of the family are very large flightless birds native to Australia-New Guinea.
wikipedia.title: Casuariidae

wikipedia.extract: The Casuariiformes is an order of large flightless birds that has four surviving members: the three species of cassowary, and the only remaining species of emu. All four are placed in a single family, Casuariidae.
wikipedia.title: Casuariiformes

commonNames.name: Geoffroy's Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The greater dwarf lemur (Cheirogaleus major), or the Geoffroy's dwarf lemur, is a lemur that is widely distributed over the primary and secondary forests near the eastern coast of Madagascar. They are also found in northern parts of Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Greater dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: Hierococcyx or hawk-cuckoos is a genus of birds in the cuckoo family Cuculidae. They are distributed in South, Southeast, and East Asia.
wikipedia.title: Hierococcyx

wikipedia.extract: Aglaeactis is a genus of hummingbirds in the family Trochilidae.
wikipedia.title: Aglaeactis

wikipedia.extract: The sooty albatrosses are small albatrosses from the genus Phoebetria. There are two species, the sooty albatross, Phoebetria fusca, and the light-mantled albatross, Phoebetria palpebrata.
wikipedia.title: Phoebetria

wikipedia.extract: Mycteria is a genus of large subtropical and tropical storks (family Ciconiidae) with representatives in the Americas, east Africa, and southern and southeastern Asia. Two species have "ibis" in their scientific or old common names, but they are not related to these birds, and merely resemble some bald-headed ibises.
wikipedia.title: Mycteria

wikipedia.extract: Balaenicipitidae is a family of birds in the order Pelecaniformes, although it was traditionally placed in Ciconiiformes. The shoebill is the sole extant species and its closest relative is the hamerkop (Scopus umbretta), which belongs to another family.
wikipedia.title: Balaenicipitidae

commonNames.name: Indochinese Silvered Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Germain's langur (Trachypithecus germaini) is an Old World monkey native to Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam. The monkey was previously included in Trachypithecus cristatus and Trachypithecus villosus.
wikipedia.title: Germain's langur

commonNames.name: Maize
commonNames.source: Checklist of Vascular Plants in Korea

wikipedia.extract: Maize (; Zea mays), also known as corn, is a tall stout grass that produces cereal grain. The leafy stalk of the plant gives rise to male inflorescences or tassels which produce pollen, and female inflorescences called ears.
wikipedia.title: Maize

wikipedia.extract: Chaetura is a genus of needletail swifts found in the Americas. Although they resemble swallows, the two are not at all closely related; this is instead a result of convergent evolution.
wikipedia.title: Chaetura

wikipedia.extract: The Apodiformes is an order, or taxonomic grouping, of birds which traditionally contained three living families—the Apodidae (swifts), the Hemiprocnidae (treeswifts), and the Trochilidae (hummingbirds); however, in the Sibley–Ahlquist taxonomy, this order is elevated to the superorder Apodimorphae, in which hummingbirds are separated into a new order, the Trochiliformes. With nearly 450 species identified to date, it is the most diverse order of birds after the Passeriformes (the "perching" birds).
wikipedia.title: Apodiformes

wikipedia.extract: Cacatua is a genus of cockatoos known as great cockatoos found from the Philippines, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, and Solomon Islands to Australia. They have a primarily white plumage (in some species tinged pinkish or yellow), an expressive crest, and a black (subgenus Cacatua) or pale (subgenus Licmetis) bill.
wikipedia.title: Cacatua

wikipedia.extract: Smithornis is a genus of birds in the family Calyptomenidae, the broadbills. The genus comprises three species native to Africa.
wikipedia.title: Smithornis

wikipedia.extract: The mountain gorilla (Gorilla beringei beringei) is one of the two subspecies of the eastern gorilla. It is listed as endangered by the IUCN as of 2018.
wikipedia.title: Mountain gorilla

commonNames.name: Tufted Gray Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The tufted gray langur (Semnopithecus priam), also known as Madras gray langur, and Coromandel sacred langur, is an Old World monkey, one of the species of langurs. This, like other gray langurs, is mainly a leaf-eating monkey.
wikipedia.title: Tufted gray langur

wikipedia.extract: François' langur (Trachypithecus francoisi), also known as Francois' leaf monkey, the Tonkin leaf monkey, or the white side-burned black langur is a species of Old World monkey and the type species of its species group. It is one of the least studied of the species belonging to the Colobinae subfamily.
wikipedia.title: François' langur

wikipedia.extract: Thinocorus is a genus of seedsnipe, a South American family of small gregarious waders which have adapted to a vegetarian diet. These birds look superficially like partridges in structure and bill shape.
wikipedia.title: Thinocorus

wikipedia.extract: The thick-billed parrots are stocky brilliant green Neotropical parrots with heavy black beaks of genus Rhynchopsitta of thick billed macaw-like parrots. The genus comprises two extant species, the thick-billed parrot and the maroon-fronted parrot, as well as an extinct species from the Late Pleistocene in Mexico.
wikipedia.title: Rhynchopsitta

wikipedia.extract: Arthropods ( AR-thrə-pod) are invertebrates in the phylum Arthropoda. They possess an exoskeleton with a cuticle made of chitin, often mineralised with calcium carbonate, a body with differentiated (metameric) segments, and paired jointed appendages.
wikipedia.title: Arthropod

wikipedia.extract: Callaeidae (sometimes Callaeatidae) is a family of passerine birds endemic to New Zealand. It contains three genera, with five species in the family.
wikipedia.title: Callaeidae

wikipedia.extract: Cormobates is a genus of bird in the Australasian treecreeper family. Its scientific name means ‘trunk-creeper’, from the Greek cormos (κορµός, ‘tree trunk’) and bates (βάτης, ‘one who treads’).
wikipedia.title: Cormobates

wikipedia.extract: Cnidaria ( nih-DAIR-ee-ə, ny-) is a phylum of animals containing over 11,000 species of aquatic invertebrates found both in freshwater and marine environments (predominantly the latter), including jellyfish, hydroids, sea anemones, corals and some of the smallest marine parasites. Their distinguishing features are a decentralized nerve net distributed throughout a gelatinous body, and the presence of cnidocytes or cnidoblasts, specialized cells with ejectable organelles used mainly for envenomation and capturing prey.
wikipedia.title: Cnidaria

commonNames.name: Brown Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown titi monkey (Plecturocebus brunneus) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, from South America. It is endemic to Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Brown titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Glaucis is a genus of hummingbird in the family Trochilidae.
wikipedia.title: Glaucis

wikipedia.extract: The common ostrich (Struthio camelus), or simply ostrich, is a species of flightless bird native to certain areas of Africa (and historically, Arabia) and is the largest living species of bird. The common ostrich is one of two extant species of ostriches, the only living members of the genus Struthio in the ratite group of birds.
wikipedia.title: Common ostrich

wikipedia.extract: Onychoprion is a genus of four species of terns in the family Laridae. The genus name is from Ancient Greek onux, "claw" or "nail", and prion, "saw".
wikipedia.title: Onychoprion

commonNames.name: Bemaraha Woolly Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Bemaraha woolly lemur (Avahi cleesei), also known as Cleese's woolly lemur, is a species of woolly lemur native to western Madagascar, named after John Cleese. The first scientist to discover the species named it after Cleese, star of Monty Python, mainly because of Cleese's fondness for lemurs, as shown in Operation Lemur with John Cleese and Fierce Creatures, and his efforts at protecting and preserving them.
wikipedia.title: Bemaraha woolly lemur

wikipedia.extract: The capuchin monkeys () are New World monkeys of the subfamily Cebinae. They are famous for their complex foraging skills, such as tool use to crack open nuts.
wikipedia.title: Capuchin monkey

wikipedia.extract: The Antarctic petrel (Thalassoica antarctica) is a boldly marked dark brown and white petrel, found in Antarctica, most commonly in the Ross and Weddell Seas. They eat Antarctic krill, fish, and small squid.
wikipedia.title: Antarctic petrel

wikipedia.extract: The blue petrel (Halobaena caerulea) is a small seabird in the shearwater and petrel family, Procellariidae. This small petrel is the only member of the genus Halobaena, but is closely allied to the prions.
wikipedia.title: Blue petrel

commonNames.name: Brown Teal
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown teal (Anas chlorotis; Māori: pāteke) is a species of dabbling duck of the genus Anas native to New Zealand. It was long considered conspecific with the flightless Auckland and Campbell teals as Anas aucklandica; the name "brown teal" has also been largely applied to that entire taxon.
wikipedia.title: Brown teal

commonNames.name: Auckland Teal
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Auckland teal (Anas aucklandica) (Māori: Tētē kākāriki), also known as Auckland Islands teal, is a species of dabbling duck of the genus Anas that is endemic to Auckland Islands south of New Zealand. The species was once found throughout the Auckland Islands, but is now restricted to the islands that lack introduced predators: Adams Island, Enderby Island, Disappointment Island and a few smaller islands.
wikipedia.title: Auckland teal

wikipedia.extract: Oreopholus is a genus of bird belonging to the family Charadriidae. The tawny-throated dotterel (Oreopholus ruficollis) is the only extant species, although another species, Oreopholus orcesi, is known from the Late Pleistocene of Ecuador.
wikipedia.title: Oreopholus

wikipedia.extract: Mergus is the genus containing the typical mergansers ( mur-GAN-sərz), fish-eating ducks in the subfamily Anatinae. The common merganser or goosander (Mergus merganser) and red-breasted merganser (M. serrator) have broad ranges in the northern hemisphere.
wikipedia.title: Mergus

wikipedia.extract: Megaladapis, informally known as the koala lemur, is an extinct genus of lemurs belonging to the family Megaladapidae, consisting of three species that once inhabited the island of Madagascar. The largest measured between 1.3 to 1.5 m (4 to 5 ft) in length.
wikipedia.title: Megaladapis

wikipedia.extract: Leptotila is a genus of birds in the dove and pigeon family Columbidae. These are ground-foraging doves that live in the Americas.
wikipedia.title: Leptotila

wikipedia.extract: The mantled guereza (Colobus guereza), also known simply as the guereza, historically the eastern black-and-white colobus, and Abyssinian black-and-white colobus, is a black-and-white colobus, a type of Old World monkey. It is native to much of west central and east Africa, including Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and Chad.
wikipedia.title: Mantled guereza

commonNames.name: Kipunji
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Golden Bamboo Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Hapalemur aureus Meier, Albignac, Peyriéras, Rumpler & Wright, 1987

wikipedia.extract: The golden bamboo lemur (Hapalemur aureus), bokombolomena or varibolomena in Malagasy, is a medium-sized bamboo lemur endemic to south-eastern Madagascar. It is able to ingest twelve times as much cyanide as would be considered lethal for other species of its size.
wikipedia.title: Golden bamboo lemur

commonNames.name: Golden Angwantibo
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The golden angwantibo (Arctocebus aureus) is a strepsirrhine primate of the family Lorisidae that is endemic to west-central Africa. It is native to Cameroon, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea and Gabon, where it can be found in small, localised distributions.
wikipedia.title: Golden angwantibo

wikipedia.extract: Chondrohierax is a genus of birds of prey in the family Accipitridae, with two species. The hook-billed kite is widespread in the warmer parts of the Americas, while the Cuban kite is a critically endangered Cuban endemic that is rarely seen.
wikipedia.title: Chondrohierax

wikipedia.extract: Alisterus is a genus of medium-sized Australasian parrots, comprising the Australian king parrot (Alisterus scapularis), the Papuan king parrot (A. chloropterus) and the Moluccan king parrot (A. amboinensis). The three species are respectively found in eastern Australia, Papua, the Moluccas and other Indonesian islands.
wikipedia.title: Alisterus

wikipedia.extract: Conopophaga is a genus of birds in the gnateater family. Its members are found in forest and woodland in South America.
wikipedia.title: Conopophaga

wikipedia.extract: The Shan State langur (Trachypithecus phayrei shanicus) is a subspecies of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is found in eastern Myanmar and southwest China.
wikipedia.title: Shan State langur

wikipedia.extract: Guttera is a genus of birds in the family Numididae. The four species are found in forests of sub-Saharan Africa.
wikipedia.title: Guttera

commonNames.name: Black-headed Night Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-headed night monkey (Aotus nigriceps) is a night monkey species from South America. It is found in Brazil, Bolivia and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Black-headed night monkey

wikipedia.extract: The Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) is a species of ray-finned fish in the family Salmonidae. It is the third largest of the Salmonidae, behind Siberian taimen and Pacific Chinook salmon, growing up to 1 m (3.3 ft) in length.
wikipedia.title: Atlantic salmon

commonNames.name: Barbary Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Barbary macaque (Macaca sylvanus) is a macaque species native to the Atlas Mountains of Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, along with a small introduced population in Gibraltar. It is the type species of the genus Macaca.
wikipedia.title: Barbary macaque

commonNames.name: Rhesus Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Macaco Rhesus
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta), colloquially rhesus monkey, is a species of Old World monkey in the Macaca genus. There are between six and nine recognised subspecies split between two groups, the Chinese-derived and the Indian-derived.
wikipedia.title: Rhesus macaque

wikipedia.extract: Macaca fascicularis, variously known by common names such as crab-eating macaque, long-tailed macaque, or cynomolgus monkey, is a macaque species native to Southeast Asia. As a synanthropic species, the crab-eating macaque thrives near human settlements and in secondary forests.
wikipedia.title: Macaca fascicularis

wikipedia.extract: Animals are multicellular, eukaryotic organisms belonging to the biological kingdom Animalia (). Animals consume organic material, breathe oxygen, have muscle cells, can reproduce sexually, and grow from a hollow sphere of cells, the blastula, during embryonic development.
wikipedia.title: Animal

wikipedia.extract: The indri ( ; Indri indri), also called the babakoto, is one of the largest living lemurs, with a head-body length of about 64–72 cm (25–28+1⁄2 in) and a weight of between 6 and 9.5 kg (13 and 21 lb). It has a black and white coat and maintains an upright posture when climbing or clinging.
wikipedia.title: Indri

commonNames.name: Indri
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The indri ( ; Indri indri), also called the babakoto, is one of the largest living lemurs, with a head-body length of about 64–72 cm (25–28+1⁄2 in) and a weight of between 6 and 9.5 kg (13 and 21 lb). It has a black and white coat and maintains an upright posture when climbing or clinging.
wikipedia.title: Indri

wikipedia.extract: Streptoprocne is a genus of swifts in the family Apodidae. It contains five species that exist in Central and South America.
wikipedia.title: Streptoprocne

wikipedia.extract: Ammoperdix is a small genus in the pheasant family Phasianidae of the order Galliformes.
wikipedia.title: Ammoperdix

wikipedia.extract: Notharchus is a genus of puffbird in the Bucconidae family. The genus was introduced by the German ornithologists Jean Cabanis and Ferdinand Heine in 1863.
wikipedia.title: Notharchus

wikipedia.extract: Steatornithidae is a family of birds comprising a single extant species, the oilbird (Steatornis caripensis) and the extinct genus Euronyctibius. Steatornithidae is currently considered the only member of the order Steatornithiformes, however, in the past, it was classified in the order Caprimulgiformes, along with all other members of the clade Strisores.
wikipedia.title: Steatornithidae

wikipedia.extract: Lemuriformes is the sole extant infraorder of primate that falls under the suborder Strepsirrhini. It includes the lemurs of Madagascar, as well as the galagos and lorisids of Africa and Asia, although a popular alternative taxonomy places the lorisoids in their own infraorder, Lorisiformes.
wikipedia.title: Lemuriformes

wikipedia.extract: Chiromyiformes is an infraorder of strepsirrhine primates that includes the aye-aye from Madagascar and its extinct relatives.
wikipedia.title: Chiromyiformes

wikipedia.extract: Strepsirrhini or Strepsirhini ( ; STREP-sə-RY-nee) is a suborder of primates that includes the lemuriform primates, which consist of the lemurs of Madagascar, galagos ("bushbabies") and pottos from Africa, and the lorises from India and Southeast Asia. Collectively they are referred to as strepsirrhines.
wikipedia.title: Strepsirrhini

wikipedia.extract: The Recurvirostridae are a family of birds in the wader suborder Charadrii. It contains two distinct groups of birds, the avocets (one genus) and the stilts (two genera).
wikipedia.title: Recurvirostridae

wikipedia.extract: The banded stilt (Cladorhynchus leucocephalus) is a wader of the stilt and avocet family, Recurvirostridae, native to Australia. It belongs to the monotypic genus Cladorhynchus.
wikipedia.title: Banded stilt

wikipedia.extract: Touit is a genus of Neotropical parrots in the family Psittacidae. The genus was introduced by the English zoologist George Robert Gray in 1855 with the scarlet-shouldered parrotlet (Touit huetii) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Touit

wikipedia.extract: Merulaxis or bristlefronts, is a genus of bird in the family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Merulaxis

wikipedia.extract: Oryza sativa, having the common name Asian cultivated rice, is the much more common of the two rice species cultivated as a cereal, the other species being O. glaberrima, African rice. It was first domesticated in the Yangtze River basin in China 13,500 to 8,200 years ago.
wikipedia.title: Oryza sativa

wikipedia.extract: Scelorchilus is a genus of bird in the family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Scelorchilus

commonNames.name: Dian's Tarsier
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Dian's tarsier (Tarsius dentatus), also known as the Diana tarsier, is a nocturnal primate endemic to central Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its head-body length is 11.5–12 centimetres (4.5–4.7 in) and it has a tail of 22 centimetres (8.7 in).
wikipedia.title: Dian's tarsier

wikipedia.extract: Nomascus is the second-most speciose genus of the gibbon family, Hylobatidae. Originally, this genus was a subgenus of Hylobates, with all individuals considered to be one species, H. concolor.
wikipedia.title: Nomascus

wikipedia.extract: The Angola colobus (Colobus angolensis), Angolan black-and-white colobus, or Angolan colobus is a primate species of Old World monkey belonging to the genus Colobus.
wikipedia.title: Angola colobus

wikipedia.extract: The Canada goose (Branta canadensis) is a large species of goose with a black head and neck, white cheeks, white under its chin, and a brown body. It is native to the Arctic and temperate regions of North America, and it is occasionally found during migration across the Atlantic in northern Europe.
wikipedia.title: Canada goose

wikipedia.extract: The black geese or white-cheeked geese of the genus Branta are waterfowl belonging to the true goose and swan subfamily Anserinae. They occur in the northern coastal regions of the Palearctic and all over North America, migrating to more southerly coasts in winter, and as resident birds in the Hawaiian Islands.
wikipedia.title: Branta

wikipedia.extract: Phlogophilus, or the piedtails, are a small genus of hummingbirds. It contains two species.
wikipedia.title: Phlogophilus

wikipedia.extract: Geoffroyus is a genus of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. The four species are found in and around New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, northern Australia and the islands of Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Geoffroyus

wikipedia.extract: The black-tailed godwit (Limosa limosa) is a large, long-legged, long-billed shorebird first described by Carl Linnaeus in 1758. It is a member of the godwit genus, Limosa.
wikipedia.title: Black-tailed godwit

commonNames.name: Allen's Swamp Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Allen's swamp monkey (Allenopithecus nigroviridis) is a species of Old World monkey endemic to swamps and riparian forests in the central Congo Basin. As a medium-sized primate, adult individuals can have head-body lengths of up to 18 in (46 cm), with tails being slightly longer.
wikipedia.title: Allen's swamp monkey

commonNames.name: Angolan Colobus
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Angola colobus (Colobus angolensis), Angolan black-and-white colobus, or Angolan colobus is a primate species of Old World monkey belonging to the genus Colobus.
wikipedia.title: Angola colobus

wikipedia.extract: The doucs or douc langurs make up the genus Pygathrix. They are colobine Old World monkeys, native to Southeast Asia, consisting of 3 species: red-shanked douc, black-shanked douc, and gray-shanked douc.
wikipedia.title: Douc

wikipedia.extract: The banded kingfisher (Lacedo pulchella) is a tree kingfisher found in lowland tropical forests of southeast Asia. It is the only member of the genus Lacedo.
wikipedia.title: Banded kingfisher

wikipedia.extract: Callipepla is a genus of birds in the New World quail family, Odontophoridae. They are sometimes referred to as crested quails.
wikipedia.title: Callipepla

wikipedia.extract: The wild boar (Sus scrofa), also known as the wild swine, common wild pig, Eurasian wild pig, or simply wild pig, is a suid native to much of Eurasia and North Africa and has been introduced to the Americas and Oceania. The species is now one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world as well as the most widespread suiform.
wikipedia.title: Wild boar

commonNames.name: Gerp's Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus gerpi Radespiel, Ratsimbazafy, Rasoloharijaona, Raveloson, Andriaholinirina, Rakotondravony et al., 2011

wikipedia.extract: Gerp's mouse lemur (Microcebus gerpi) is a species of mouse lemur known only from the Sahafina Forest in eastern Madagascar, near Mantadia National Park. Its discovery was announced in 2012 by a German and Malagasy research team.
wikipedia.title: Gerp's mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Anseranatidae, the magpie-geese, is a biological family of waterbirds. The only living species, the magpie goose, is a resident breeder in northern Australia and in southern New Guinea.
wikipedia.title: Anseranatidae

wikipedia.extract: The budgerigar ( BUJ-ər-ih-gar, -⁠ə-ree-; Melopsittacus undulatus), also known as the common parakeet, shell parakeet or budgie ( BUJ-ee), is a small, long-tailed, seed-eating parrot native to Australia. Naturally, the species is green and yellow with black, scalloped markings on the nape, back, and wings.
wikipedia.title: Budgerigar

commonNames.name: Silvery Lutung
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The silvery lutung (Trachypithecus cristatus), also known as the silvered leaf monkey or the silvery langur, is an Old World monkey. It is arboreal, living in coastal, mangrove, and riverine forests in Sumatra, Borneo, Java, as well as in parts of the southwestern Malay Peninsula, the Natuna Islands, and other nearby islands.
wikipedia.title: Silvery lutung

wikipedia.extract: The black-crowned Central American squirrel monkey (Saimiri oerstedii oerstedii) is a subspecies of the Central American squirrel monkey. Its range is restricted to the Pacific coast of western Panama to the western portion of the Chiriquí Province and of southern Costa Rica, south of the Rio Grande de Terraba, including the Osa Peninsula.
wikipedia.title: Black-crowned Central American squirrel monkey

wikipedia.extract: The skimmers, forming the genus Rynchops (from Ancient Greek ῥύγχος (rhúnkhos), meaning "beak", and ὄψ (óps), meaning "face"), are tern-like birds in the family Laridae. The genus comprises three species found in South Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
wikipedia.title: Rynchops

commonNames.name: Mandrill
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Mandril
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The mandrill (Mandrillus sphinx) is a large Old World monkey native to west central Africa. It is one of the most colorful mammals in the world, with red and blue skin on its face and posterior.
wikipedia.title: Mandrill

wikipedia.extract: Theropithecus is a genus of primates in the family Cercopithecidae. It contains a single living species, the gelada (Theropithecus gelada), native to the Ethiopian Highlands.
wikipedia.title: Theropithecus

commonNames.name: Gelada
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The gelada (Theropithecus gelada, Amharic: ጭላዳ, romanized: č̣əlada, Oromo: Jaldeessa daabee), sometimes called the bleeding-heart monkey or the gelada baboon, is a species of Old World monkey found only in the Ethiopian Highlands, living at elevations of 1,800–4,400 m (5,900–14,400 ft) above sea level. It is the only living member of the genus Theropithecus, a name derived from the Greek root words for "beast-ape" (θηρο-πίθηκος : thēro-píthēkos).
wikipedia.title: Gelada

wikipedia.extract: Mandrillus is a genus of large Old World monkeys distributed throughout central and southern Africa, consisting of two species: M. sphinx and M. leucophaeus, the mandrill and drill, respectively. Mandrillus, originally placed under the genus Papio as a type of baboon, is closely related to the genus Cercocebus.
wikipedia.title: Mandrillus

commonNames.name: Drill
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The drill (Mandrillus leucophaeus) is a primate of the family Cercopithecidae (Old World monkeys), related to baboons and even more closely to the mandrill. The average wild drill has a lifespan of 20 years.
wikipedia.title: Drill (animal)

wikipedia.extract: The Colobinae or leaf-eating monkeys are a subfamily of the Old World monkey family that includes 61 species in 11 genera, including the black-and-white colobus, the large-nosed proboscis monkey, and the gray langurs. Some classifications split the colobine monkeys into two tribes, while others split them into three groups.
wikipedia.title: Colobinae

wikipedia.extract: Sclerurus is a bird genus in the ovenbird family, Furnariidae. Members of this genus are commonly known as leaftossers or leafscrapers, and are found in Mexico, Central America and South America.
wikipedia.title: Sclerurus

wikipedia.extract: Chamaeza is a genus of South American birds in the family Formicariidae. The genus was erected by the Irish zoologist Nicholas Aylward Vigors in 1825 with the cryptic antthrush (Chamaeza meruloides) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Chamaeza

wikipedia.extract: The house sparrow (Passer domesticus) is a bird of the sparrow family Passeridae, found in most parts of the world. It is a small bird that has a typical length of 16 cm (6.3 in) and a mass of 24–39.5 g (0.85–1.39 oz).
wikipedia.title: House sparrow

wikipedia.extract: Mullerornis modestus is an extinct species of elephant bird, and the only member of the genus Mullerornis.
wikipedia.title: Mullerornis

commonNames.name: Bearded Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-striped capuchin (Sapajus libidinosus), also known as the bearded capuchin, is a New World monkey in the family Cebidae. They are native to northern and central Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Black-striped capuchin

wikipedia.extract: Talegalla is a genus of bird in the family Megapodiidae. First described by René Primevère Lesson in 1828, it contains the following species: Red-billed brushturkey (Talegalla cuvieri) Black-billed brushturkey (Talegalla fuscirostris) Collared brushturkey (Talegalla jobiensis) The name Talegalla is a combination of taleve, the French word for swamphen, and gallus, the Latin word for "cock".
wikipedia.title: Talegalla

wikipedia.extract: The eastern chimpanzee (Pan troglodytes schweinfurthii) is a subspecies of the common chimpanzee. It is native to the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, and Tanzania.
wikipedia.title: Eastern chimpanzee

commonNames.name: African Wood-owl
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The African wood owl (Strix woodfordii) or Woodford's owl, is a typical owl from the genus Strix in the family Strigidae and is arguably the most common forest owl in Africa. It inhabits wooded areas and possesses a distinctive call.
wikipedia.title: African wood owl

wikipedia.extract: The bald uakari (Cacajao calvus) or bald-headed uakari is a small New World monkey characterized by a very short tail, a bright, crimson face, bald head, and long coat. The bald uakari is restricted to várzea forests and other wooded habitats near water in the western Amazon of Brazil and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Bald uakari

commonNames.name: Antafia Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
